project.description: The primary container for application source definitions and build targets.

version.description: The version of Bouer used by the project.

context.description: The root directory of the project source files.

entry.description: The entry point of the application relative to the project context.

build.description: Project build configuration, contains webpack chunking, output target, and environment configurations.

index.description: The HTML file used as the application's entry document.

outputPath.description: The directory where the generated build files are placed.

assets.description: A list of files and directories that should be copied to the build output without being processed.

development.description: Configuration options used when building the project in development mode.

production.description: Configuration options used when building the project for production.

budgets.description: Performance and asset size threshold limits applied during the production build.

entry.description: Configuration settings for the project entry entrypoints.

resources.description: Configuration settings for project resources and static assets.

cli.description: Dictates scaffold file extensions and directory targets during generator commands.

component:scaffold.description: Configuration for generating project files and components using the Bouer CLI.

view.description: The default file type used for component views.

style.description: The default stylesheet language (extension) used when generating components.

script.description: The default scripting language (extension) used when generating components.

templates.description: Custom scaffold templates that define where generated files are placed and how their names are suffixed.

blank.description: Configuration settings for scaffolding `blank` or generic components.

server.description: Configuration for the Bouer development server.

hot.description: Enables Hot Module Replacement (HMR) so that changes can be reflected without fully reloading the application.

port.description: The network port used by the development server.

staticDir.description: The directory from which static files are served.

publicPath.description: The public URL path from which application assets are served.

compress.description: Enables compression for files served by the development server.

openBrowser.description: Automatically opens the application in the default browser when the development server starts.

filename.description: The main filename used for the generated bundle.

hash.description: The hash pattern used in generated filenames. Use 'none' to disable filename hashing or a Webpack hash placeholder such as '[contenthash:8]'.

tsConfig.description: The path to the TypeScript configuration file used for the build.

minimize.description: Enables minification and code optimization for generated assets.

splitChunks.description: Enables chunk splitting to isolate shared dependencies and vendor code.

devtool.description: Defines the source map strategy used to generate debugging maps. Set to false to disable source maps in production mode.

webpackMixConfig.description: Specifies the path to a custom Webpack file that will be merged with the base Webpack configuration.

path.description: The directory where files generated for this scaffold type are placed.

suffix.description: The suffix appended to the generated component or class name.

maximumWarning.description: The maximum warning threshold for the budget.

maximumError.description: The maximum error threshold for the budget.

exclude.description: A list of files, directories or a regex that should be excluded from the budget.
